trip.hotelsIntro: All Marriott Bonvoy. Ranked for this family: how likely a Titanium/Platinum member is to get a suite (from Flyert 飞客, SMZDM, Trip.com, TripAdvisor and FlyerTalk reports), how new the hotel is, and the location. Vote for a hotel for each stay (Chengdu has two stays, so you can try two hotels).
trip.hotelsTip: Rooms for 10: plan on 4–5 rooms, with connecting rooms for each family and a room near the lift for the grandparents. Hotels in China often limit rooms to 2 adults + 1 child, so confirm the cot, extra bed and kids' breakfast rules when you book.
trip.about: Flights MH526 / MH527 are booked; exact times are on the e-ticket. Trains, vans and hotels are not booked yet and are marked tentative. Map opens the place in 高德地图 Amap, Google Maps or Apple Maps. Votes are saved online under the name you type (no accounts); your notes and plan changes stay on this phone.

elite: Book each room under a different Platinum/Titanium member's own Bonvoy account, with that person staying in the room. Upgrades, lounge access and breakfast go to the member in the room, so 5 rooms means 5 separate chances at a suite.
Book direct on Marriott.com or the Bonvoy app. Most third-party bookings (Trip.com, Agoda) don't get elite benefits.
Titanium members: put Suite Night Awards on the rooms that matter most (the grandparents' room and the room with the baby). They're confirmed a few days before arrival.

About 1–2 weeks before, email the hotel: a multi-generational family of 10, all Titanium/Platinum, 5 rooms. Ask for connecting or adjacent rooms, suites if available, a cot, and how many people can use the lounge per room.
Chengdu is one hotel with a 3-night + 2-night split: ask them to note the upgrade on both bookings, so you return to the same suite on 19 Dec.
Check the breakfast and lounge rules for children when you book; hotels often cap it at the member plus one guest, and kids' rules vary.
Since 2025 Marriott only promises "an upgrade", not a suite, and upgrades in China are now decided by an algorithm, so treat suites as likely, not guaranteed.

days.label: Family's pick: day trip or city
Last day · fly home after midnight

items.name: People's Park & Heming Teahouse 人民公园 · 鹤鸣茶社
items.info: Chengdu at its most relaxed: bamboo chairs by the lake, a pot of jasmine tea, ear-cleaners doing the rounds, grandparents dancing. Flat paths all the way round.

items.name: Kuanzhai Alley 宽窄巷子
items.info: Three restored Qing-era lanes of courtyard houses, snacks and tea shops. Flat and pram-friendly; busy after 5pm, so hold small hands.

items.name: Giant Panda Base 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
items.info: Go at opening: pandas are most active in the cool morning. Use the ¥10 park shuttle bus between enclosures to save little and older legs. The nurseries with cubs are the highlight.
items.mapq: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
items.mapen: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
items.book: Tickets open 14 days ahead (from Tue 1 Dec) on Trip.com or the base's WeChat mini-program; passport for each person. Book the shuttle bus at the same time.

items.name: Back to the hotel — nap & rest
items.info: Early start and a long walk: nap time for the baby and a rest for the elderly before the evening.

items.name: Lunch on the train
items.info: Buy buns and snacks at Chengdu East before boarding, or order a hot meal to your seat when booking on Trip.com / 铁路12306. Hot water taps in every carriage for baby bottles.

items.name: Big Wild Goose Pagoda 大雁塔
items.info: The 7th-century Tang pagoda, beautifully lit at dusk (sunset about 17:39). The squares around it are free and flat; the temple grounds close 17:30 in winter, so this is the squares and the lights.

items.name: Great Tang All Day Mall night walk 大唐不夜城
items.info: A long pedestrian boulevard of Tang-dynasty light sculptures and street performers running south from the pagoda. Flat and wide, fine for strollers and wheelchairs. Very cold after dark in December. The fountain on the pagoda North Square runs about 20:30–21:00 on weekdays (confirm on the 曲江新区 account), so finish the walk there. If you stay at the Ritz, one van takes the grandparents and the baby back after dinner. The street is car-free: meet the vans at 曲江大悦城 south side. Rain or snow: stay in 曲江大悦城 mall.

items.name: Terracotta Army 秦始皇兵马俑
items.info: Start at Pit 1 (the famous rows of 2,000-year-old warriors), then Pits 3 and 2. It's a long walk from the car park to the pits, so pace it for the elderly and bring the baby carrier as well as the stroller. The halls are big and cold in winter.
items.book: Online only on the official WeChat, time-slotted, 7 days ahead (from Thu 10 Dec; retry 11 Dec); passport for each person. Take the 09:30 slot. Private van for the day: about 1h each way, 1h15–1h30 from the Ritz. Car park to gate is a 5-min walk, then 1 km between gates: take the ¥5 electric cart for the grandparents and pram. If the morning runs late, 后宫园林 on 秦唐大道 is on the way for lunch.

items.name: Shaanxi History Museum 陕西历史博物馆
items.info: One of China's great museums: Tang gold and silver, murals, Zhou bronzes. Warm and indoor, a good morning for everyone after yesterday's walking.
items.book: Free, but tickets are a sprint: released 5 days ahead at 17:00 China time, only on the 陕西历史博物馆 WeChat account, real-name, gone in seconds. For Fri 18 Dec that is Sun 13 Dec 17:00 (at KLIA before the flight). If Friday sells out, 14 Dec 17:00 releases Sat 19 Dec: take that and swap it with Saturday's photoshoot. Pre-enter every passport first. Under-6s (or under 1.4 m) and over-65s need no ticket. Winter 09:00–17:30, last entry 16:00, closed Mondays. Plan B if it fails: Small Wild Goose Pagoda + Xi'an Museum (free) this morning.

items.name: City Wall at South Gate 永宁门
items.info: The most complete old city wall in China, about 14km round and wide enough to cycle. Bikes for the energetic; everyone else strolls a short stretch for the view. South Gate is stairs only, so go up as one group by the lift at 含光门 (inside the Hanguang Gate museum, family toilets on top), stroll a short stretch, come down the same lift and have the vans meet you there. It is about 1.5 km along the wall to South Gate, too far there and back for the grandparents. Winter 08:00–19:00, last entry 18:00.
items.mapen: Yongningmen South Gate Xi'an City Wall

items.name: Bell & Drum Towers 钟楼 · 鼓楼
items.info: The two Ming towers at the heart of the old city, lit up at dusk. Winter 08:30–18:00, last entry 17:30. Entry is through the underpass (metro exit C has a lift) and the tower is spiral stairs, so the grandparents enjoy it from the free square. No stopping at the roundabout: meet the vans on 西大街 by De Fa Chang.

items.name: Lunch on the train
items.info: No time for a sit-down lunch at the station: buy buns and roujiamo at Xi'an North, or order a hot meal to your seat when booking on Trip.com / 铁路12306. Hot water taps in every carriage.

items.name: Rest, showers & pack (keep the rooms)
items.info: The flight leaves after midnight. Keep the rooms until evening (late check-out, or book the night of 21 Dec) so the baby naps and everyone showers before the airport.

items.name: Sichuan Opera face-changing show 蜀风雅韵
items.info: Chengdu's classic evening show in a teahouse theatre: face-changing, fire-spitting, shadow puppets, comic sketches. Seats with tea. Closer to the JW Marriott: 锦江剧场 Jinjiang Theatre's 《川剧秀·传奇变脸》, nightly 20:00 (weekends 20:30).
items.book: Book 1–2 days ahead on Trip.com.

details.what: A 90-minute variety show of Sichuan opera highlights in a teahouse theatre: face-changing (masks switch in a blink), fire-spitting, hand-shadow puppets, the rolling-lamp comedy and folk music. Easy to enjoy without understanding Chinese.
details.price: ¥88–¥498 depending on seat (蜀风雅韵, Culture Park); similar at 锦江剧场 near Chunxi Road
details.kids: Fast and colourful, kids love the face-changing; gongs are loud for the baby, and it ends ~21:30
details.watch: 蜀风雅韵 川剧变脸

items.name: Jinli Street lanterns 锦里
items.info: Red lanterns reflected in the ponds, snack stalls, next to Wuhou Shrine. Pretty and short.

items.name: Early night: jet-lag recovery
items.info: We landed after midnight. Bath, bed.

items.name: Panda Tower night view 天府熊猫塔
items.info: The 339m TV tower, now 'Tianfu Panda Tower': a 1-minute lift to the 230m deck for Chengdu's best night view, with the Mengzhuiwan riverside bars below. Indoor deck, warm in December.
items.book: Tickets about ¥80 (standard lift) or ¥100 (sightseeing lift); under 1.2m free, discounts for 1.2–1.4m children and over-60s. Winter hours 10:00–21:00; confirm last entry and prices on its official account before going.

details.what: Chengdu's 339 m TV tower, rebranded Tianfu Panda Tower: a 1-minute lift to the 230 m indoor deck for the city lights, with riverside bars below.
details.price: ¥80 standard lift / ¥100 sightseeing lift; under 1.2 m free, discounts for 1.2–1.4 m and over-60s
details.elderly: Lift all the way, little walking
details.watch: 天府熊猫塔 夜景

items.name: Taikoo Li, Daci Temple & the IFS panda 太古里 · 大慈寺
items.info: Low-rise open-air shopping streets around a Buddhist temple, then the giant panda climbing the side of IFS. Christmas lights in December.

items.name: Wuhou Shrine & Jinli 武侯祠 · 锦里
items.info: Memorial temple to the Three Kingdoms heroes (Zhuge Liang, Liu Bei) with red walls and bamboo, then the lantern street next door.

items.name: Hotel pool, lounge & free time
items.info: Swim, tea, naps. Save energy for Xi'an.

items.name: Eastern Suburb Memory 东郊记忆
items.info: A 1950s electronics factory turned art and music park: red-brick halls, old chimneys, cafés, and the red 'Chengdu wall' that fills Xiaohongshu. Free, open all day, flat paths.

details.what: A 1950s electronics factory turned art and music park: red-brick halls, chimneys, cafés and the red 'Chengdu wall' photo spot.
details.elderly: Flat paths, cafés to sit in
details.watch: 东郊记忆 拍照

items.name: Huaqing Palace 华清宫
items.info: Tang emperors' hot-spring palace at the foot of Mount Li, next to the Terracotta Army. Gardens and pavilions by a lake. Winter 07:30–18:00, ¥80; entry only via 望京门 (Wangjing Gate).

items.name: Back to the hotel to rest
items.info: The Terracotta Army is a long morning on foot. Warm up and nap.

items.name: Xi'an Romance show 西安千古情
items.info: A big indoor song-and-dance spectacle (Songcheng) about Xi'an's history: rain on stage, flying sets and horses, at the Expo Park in Chanba, a short detour on the drive back from the Terracotta Army. Allow a ~20 min walk from the gate to the theatre, and note it makes a long day with no rest before dinner.
items.book: Tickets ¥278 / ¥328 / ¥580; under 1.2m or under 6 free without a seat (one per adult). Shows usually 13:00 / 15:30 / 17:30 / 19:00, but low season often drops afternoon shows: confirm the Thursday 15:30 exists before choosing this. Similar indoor show in the same area: 驼铃传奇 Camel Bell Legend (see Ideas).

details.what: Songcheng's indoor song-and-dance spectacle of Xi'an's history from the Zhou to the Tang dynasties: rain falling on stage, flying sets, horses and hundreds of dancers.
details.price: ¥278 / ¥328 / ¥580 by seat; under 1.2 m or under 6 free without a seat
details.elderly: About a 20-min walk from the park gate to the theatre
details.watch: 西安千古情 演出

items.name: Resurrected Legion 复活的军团
items.info: An indoor walk-through war epic about the Qin army, at 大秦剧场 (临潼区秦陵北路166号) — the theatre next door to the Terracotta Army, so it needs no extra drive on a day you are already there. Four acts over 70 minutes with 360° projection; the audience moves between sets rather than sitting in numbered seats, but the theatre runs a separate 老人、小孩通道 (elderly and children route) so the grandparents are not carried along with the crowd. Loud battle sound and vibration effects. Sessions are usually about 12:40 / 14:10 / 16:40 and change daily.
items.mapq: 大秦剧场 复活的军团
items.book: From ¥268; under 1.2 m free without a seat; real-name tickets, maximum 6 per order. Confirm the session times for your date when booking — they are set day by day. Check it is 《复活的军团》 and not 《永生的军团》, which has used the same theatre.

details.what: China's first immersive multimedia war epic: four acts over 70 minutes following two Qin soldiers, Hei Fu and Jing, from the oldest surviving Chinese family letter. A 7,000 m² set with 360° projection, a troop review and a city assault.
details.when: Several sessions a day, usually about 11:30 / 13:10 / 14:40 / 17:00 — they change daily, so confirm for your date. Venue open 09:00–18:30 all year, indoors, so it does not stop for winter. Checked Sep 2026
details.price: ¥268 (often 20% off on the official channel); under 1.2 m free without a seat; real-name tickets, max 6 per order
details.kids: ⚠ Battle scenes are loud and the floor vibrates — a lot for a baby in arms
details.elderly: A walking show with no numbered seats, BUT the theatre runs a separate elderly-and-children route, so they are not carried along with the crowd
details.getting: 大秦剧场, 临潼区秦陵北路166号 — right beside the Terracotta Army, so it adds no extra driving on Thursday
details.book: Check you are buying 《复活的军团》 and not 《永生的军团》, which has used the same theatre
details.watch: 复活的军团 演出
details.photo: No photo here — the operator blocks them. Tap 小红书 or YouTube to see the real thing.

items.name: Everlasting Regret show 长恨歌
items.info: Xi'an's most famous show: an outdoor dance-drama on the real lake at Huaqing Palace, Mount Li behind it, telling the story of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei. It is in Lintong, next to the Terracotta Army, so it follows straight on from the day there. ⚠ It normally pauses for winter (November to about February). A heated-seat winter edition (冰火长恨歌) has run from 1 December in some years but did not run in winter 2025–26, and nothing is announced yet for 2026. Confirm in November before anyone counts on it.
items.book: Only if a December run is confirmed: tickets open 5 days ahead at 09:30 China time, from ¥249. The show ticket does NOT include daytime entry to Huaqing Palace.

details.what: Xi'an's most famous show: an outdoor dance-drama staged on the real lake at Huaqing Palace, with Mount Li as the backdrop. The story of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei, told with a rising lake stage, water, fire and light.
details.when: ⚠ Winter is the problem. The regular season runs mid-March to end-October. A heated-seat winter edition (冰火长恨歌) has run from 1 December in some years (a single early show, about 18:00–19:10), but it did NOT run in winter 2025–26 and nothing is announced for 2026. Checked Sep 2026 — confirm in November.
details.price: From ¥249; under 1.3 m free without a seat. The show ticket does not include daytime entry to Huaqing Palace
details.kids: Spectacular, but outdoors at night in the cold — only worth it if a December run is confirmed
details.elderly: Seated throughout; dress very warmly, it is an open-air hillside
details.getting: Lintong, about 1 hour from the city and next to the Terracotta Army, so it follows straight on from Thursday
details.watch: 冰火长恨歌
details.photo: First three are official production photos © 长恨歌; the rest show Huaqing Palace, the venue.

items.name: Majestic Qin 赳赳大秦
items.info: A big indoor 'epic fantasy' production about the rise of Qin, from the same company as 长恨歌: moving seats, projection and stage effects rather than a traditional theatre show. 80 minutes, no interval. At Fengdong New City in the west of the city (沣东大道 × 天台路), about 30–40 min from the Bell Tower — the opposite side of town from the Terracotta Army, so this is a drive back in and out again. ⚠ Under-5s are not admitted and every seat has a safety belt; the venue also turns away anyone with heart trouble, high blood pressure or difficulty walking.
items.book: Shows 14:45 / 16:45 / 19:45 daily; book 10–15 days ahead on 大麼/猫眼 or the official site. Children 5+ pay the adult price.

details.what: A large indoor 'epic fantasy' production about the rise of the Qin dynasty, by the same company as 长恨歌. Moving seats, projection and stage machinery rather than a traditional stage show — closer to a theme-park ride with a story.
details.when: Daily 14:45 / 16:45 / 19:45, year-round (it paused only 4–9 Jan 2026 for maintenance). Checked Sep 2026
details.price: By seating zone; children 5 and over pay the adult price
details.kids: ⚠ Under-5s are NOT admitted, so the baby cannot go in. Every seat has a safety belt
details.elderly: ⚠ The venue turns away anyone with heart disease, high blood pressure, epilepsy, mobility difficulty or who is pregnant. Check before booking for the grandparents
details.getting: Fengdong New City, west of the city (沣东大道 × 天台路) — about 30–40 min from the Bell Tower and the opposite side of town from the Terracotta Army
details.book: Book 10–15 days ahead on 大麼 / 猫眼 or the official site jjdq.changhenge.cn
details.watch: 赳赳大秦
details.photo: Official production photos © 赳赳大秦. Tap a video for the real thing.

items.name: Camel Bell Legend 驼铃传奇
items.info: Indoor Silk Road epic at 华夏大剧院 (灞桥区华文路1518号): real camels and horses on stage, an avalanche, a sandstorm and fire. It sits between Lintong and the city, about 30 min from the Terracotta Army, so it works as a stop on the drive back. ⚠ The auditorium itself rotates to face each scene, and the operator's own notice warns off anyone with heart disease, high blood pressure or difficulty walking. Loud and startling for a baby (free on a lap, but not really suitable). ⚠ Sessions change weekly and the theatre takes an annual maintenance break that fell on 2–20 December in 2024 — check the dates before buying.
items.book: ¥278–458 by tier; under 1.2 m free on a lap, one per adult. Mostly non-refundable once issued. Confirm the December session times on the 华夏文旅西安度假区 WeChat the week before.

details.what: An indoor Silk Road epic: real camels and horses on stage, an avalanche, a sandstorm and fire, following a caravan out of Chang'an. Seven acts in a 3,000-seat theatre whose seating bank ROTATES to face each scene.
details.when: Four to six sessions a day between about 10:30 and 19:45; they change weekly. ⚠ The theatre also takes an annual maintenance break — it fell on 2–20 December in 2024 and 5–30 January in 2026. The 2026–27 dates are not announced. Checked Sep 2026
details.price: ¥278–458 by tier; under 1.2 m free on a lap, one per adult. Usually non-refundable once issued
details.kids: ⚠ Free on a lap, but loud percussion, water mist in the front rows and startling effects — the operator warns young children may be frightened
details.elderly: ⚠ The venue's own notice asks anyone with heart disease, high blood pressure or difficulty walking to think twice: the auditorium rotates and it is a long walk from the car park. If you go, buy a top tier for the shortest walk
details.getting: 华夏大剧院, 灞桥区华文路1518号 — about 30 min from the Terracotta Army and on the way back to the city, so it fits Thursday
details.watch: 驼铃传奇 演出
details.photo: No photo here — tap a video to see it.

items.name: Muslim Quarter street food 回民街
items.info: The old Hui neighbourhood behind the Drum Tower: lamb skewers, persimmon cakes, sticky rice cake, pomegranate juice. Very crowded, so bring the baby carrier rather than the stroller.

items.name: Tang Dynasty dinner & show 唐乐宫
items.info: Seated dinner from 18:50, then the costumed Tang-court show 《大唐女皇》 19:30–20:40 (19:00 / 20:30 on double-show days). Warm, comfortable, no walking, and done by 20:40 for the baby. 长安北路75号, 10 min from the Bell Tower.
items.book: Dinner packages ¥350 (dumpling banquet) / ¥550 (palace banquet). Winter shows run on demand, so book several days ahead on Trip.com.

details.what: Xi'an's classic Tang-court dinner show at 唐乐宫: a seated dinner, then costumed palace music and dance with a live traditional orchestra.
details.when: Dinner from 18:50, show 《大唐女皇》 19:30–20:40 (19:00 / 20:30 on double-show days)
details.watch: 唐乐宫 仿唐乐舞
details.photo: Photo: a Tang dance performance, not this theatre.

items.name: Tang palace banquet 大明宫宴
items.info: The Xiaohongshu-famous 'go to the palace for dinner': a banquet of Tang palace dishes while a 90-minute show of dance, aerial acts and light plays out on a revolving stage around the tables. Optional Tang costume and make-up before. In the old city's north, near Xi'an Railway Station (新城区笃臣路6号), about 15 min from the Bell Tower. (Photo: a similar Tang performance, not the venue.)
items.mapen: Da Ming Gong Yan Tang banquet Xian
items.book: Doors 17:30, evening show 19:00 (lunch 12:00): arrive 30 min early, or 1 h (18:00) with costumes. From about ¥263 per person with the meal; children pay the adult price; costume styling costs extra. Book 1–2 days ahead (Qunar / Trip.com or its mini-program, tel 400-009-6616) and ask for seats together for 10.

details.what: Dinner inside the show: Tang palace dishes served while dance, aerial acts and light play on a revolving stage around the tables. You can dress in Tang costume first.
details.price: From about ¥263 per person with the meal; children pay adult price; costume styling extra (kids' costumes for ages 6–16)
details.kids: Very photogenic; long sitting for the baby
details.watch: 大明宫宴
details.photo: Photo: a similar Tang performance, not this venue. Tap a video to see it.

items.name: Chang'an Twelve Hours Tang street 长安十二时辰
items.info: An indoor Tang-dynasty market street in 曼蒂广场, on the east side of the Great Tang All Day Mall: costumed performers, snack stalls, costume rental and photo corners, plus the 乐宴·盛唐 banquet show inside. Warm and indoor; about 30 min from the Bell Tower in Friday traffic. (Photo: the Great Tang All Day Mall next door, not the street itself.)
items.mapq: 长安十二时辰主题街区
items.book: Entry ¥128 adult / ¥68 child, under 1.2m free; open 10:00–22:00. The 乐宴·盛唐 banquet inside is booked separately.

details.what: An indoor Tang-dynasty market street: costumed performers, snack stalls, costume rental and photo corners, based on the TV drama.
details.price: Entry ¥68 adult / ¥38 child (1.2 m+, under 18); under 1.2 m free. Re-priced March 2026 — older pages still say ¥128. Entry covers all ~100 performances including 极乐之宴 (a 15-min Tang banquet tableau); only the immersive game costs extra
details.kids: Lots to look at; crowded at night
details.elderly: Indoor and warm, but on your feet
details.watch: 长安十二时辰 主题街区
details.photo: Photo: the Great Tang All Day Mall next door, not the street itself.

items.name: Yongxingfang food street 永兴坊
items.info: A calmer, tidier food street by the city wall, with snacks from all over Shaanxi.

items.name: No show — dinner in town and an early night
items.info: Your Thursday dinner pick near the Bell Tower, then bed after a long day on foot.

items.name: Tang costume family photoshoot 唐装 · 汉服
items.info: Rent Tang-style robes near the Big Wild Goose Pagoda and take family portraits. Hair and make-up take about 45 min a head, so two stylists from 08:00 manage about 5 people by 11:00: choose who gets styled (the kids plus 1–2 adults). Pack before you go; back at the hotel about 11:40 to change and load for the 12:15 vans. Eat a proper breakfast and carry snacks: lunch is on the 14:06 train. If Friday's museum tickets fail and you get Saturday's, swap this to Friday morning.
items.book: Book two stylists for 08:00, 1–2 days ahead (studios normally open ~10:00). Make-up ¥100–300 a head.

items.name: Small Wild Goose Pagoda & Xi'an Museum 小雁塔 · 西安博物院
items.info: Quiet temple garden with a slender Tang pagoda, and a free city museum in the same grounds. Calm and flat.

items.name: Slow morning, brunch & pack
items.info: Lie-in before the train.

items.name: G-train Chengdu East → Leshan 乐山
items.info: About 1 hour, then 30 min by van to the river pier.
items.book: Train tickets open 15 days ahead counting the travel day: Sun 6 Dec for both the outbound and return trains.

items.name: Leshan Giant Buddha by boat 乐山大佛
items.info: The 71m Buddha carved into a riverside cliff 1,200 years ago. The river boat shows the whole figure with no steps, which is best for the baby and grandparents. The path down beside the Buddha is hundreds of steep steps with long queues; optional for the fit. The boat pier has moved recently (嘉州渡码头 opened July 2025, then a November 2025 notice suspended it), so check where boats board nearer the date.

items.name: G-train Leshan → Chengdu East
items.info: Taxi or van back to Leshan station after lunch, then about 1 hour to Chengdu East.

items.name: Dujiangyan irrigation system 都江堰
items.info: A 2,200-year-old river engineering wonder that still waters the Chengdu plain: rushing water, suspension bridges and hillside temples, about 1h by van. Some slopes and steps.

items.name: Du Fu Thatched Cottage 杜甫草堂
items.info: Bamboo groves, streams and the poet Du Fu's cottage in a large, calm garden. Flat paths.

items.name: Sichuan Museum 四川博物院
items.info: Right by Du Fu's cottage: Sichuan bronzes, Han pottery, Buddhist sculpture. Free and indoor. Closed Mondays, so Sunday is its day.
items.book: Free with passport; reserve on its WeChat a few days ahead.

items.name: Chengdu Natural History Museum (dinosaurs) 成都自然博物馆
items.info: A huge hall of dinosaur skeletons found in Sichuan, plus minerals and animals. Indoor and warm, made for the kids.
items.book: Reserve on its WeChat a few days ahead; closed Mondays.

items.name: Afternoon tea & rest
items.info: Back to the hotel, or a second round of tea in People's Park.

items.name: Wenshu Monastery 文殊院
items.info: Chengdu's busiest Buddhist temple: incense and quiet courtyards. Its well-known vegetarian restaurant can replace lunch if you prefer.

items.name: Last-minute shopping: IFS & Chunxi Road
items.info: Panda souvenirs, Sichuan pepper and tea to take home.

decisions.title: Monday evening
decisions.question: After dinner on the first night, what next?

options.name: Sichuan Opera face-changing
options.blurb: The masks that change in a flash. 1.5h, seats with tea. Late-ish for the baby.

options.name: Jinli lanterns stroll
options.blurb: Short, pretty, lantern-lit old street. About 1 hour.

options.name: Early night
options.blurb: We land after midnight the night before. Sleep wins.

options.name: Panda Tower night view
options.blurb: Lift up the 339m tower for Chengdu's best city-lights view. About ¥80–100, under 1.2m free.

decisions.title: Tuesday late afternoon
decisions.question: After the pandas and a nap:

options.name: Taikoo Li + IFS panda
options.blurb: Shopping streets around an old temple, Christmas lights, the famous climbing panda.

options.name: Wuhou Shrine + Jinli
options.blurb: Three Kingdoms temple and bamboo gardens, then the lantern street.

options.name: Pool & lounge
options.blurb: A quiet afternoon at the hotel.

options.name: Eastern Suburb Memory
options.blurb: Old factory art park with the famous red Chengdu wall. Free.

decisions.title: Thursday afternoon
decisions.question: After the Terracotta Army:

options.name: Huaqing Palace
options.blurb: Imperial hot-spring gardens nearby, no extra long drive.

options.name: Hotel & rest
options.blurb: Head back, warm up and nap before dinner.

options.name: Xi'an Romance show
options.blurb: Big indoor spectacle, short detour on the drive back. From ¥278, little ones free.

decisions.title: Which show shall we book?
decisions.question: We can realistically fit ONE show, maybe two. Pick the one you most want to see and we will build the day around it. Everything below is confirmed to run in December — except 长恨歌, which is marked. ⚠ = something to read before you pick.

options.name: 复活的军团 Resurrected Legion
options.blurb: ¥268 · 70 min · indoor. Qin war epic in the theatre right next to the Terracotta Army, so it costs no extra driving on Thursday. You walk between four sets, but there is a separate elderly-and-children route. Loud battle effects.

options.name: 梦回大唐 Dream Back to the Tang
options.blurb: ¥298–518 · 60 min · indoor, and park entry included. Tang court dance in a seated theatre, 17:00–18:00. The easiest on Ah Ma and Ah Gong: sit down, warm, early finish. Free entry for over-65s.

options.name: 西安千古情 Romance of Xi'an
options.blurb: From ¥278 · 60 min · indoor. Big song-and-dance spectacle with rain, flying sets and horses on stage, at Chanba — a short detour on the drive back from the Terracotta Army. Little ones free. (It is also on the Thursday-afternoon vote.)

options.name: 赳赳大秦 Majestic Qin
options.blurb: 80 min · indoor · 19:45, west of the city. The one locals rank top: moving seats, projection and stage machinery, more ride than play. ⚠ Under-5s are NOT admitted, so the baby cannot come, and the venue turns away anyone with heart trouble, high blood pressure or difficulty walking. Dinner would have to be early.

options.name: 驼铃传奇 Camel Bell Legend
options.blurb: ¥278–458 · 70 min · indoor. Silk Road epic with real camels and horses, between Lintong and the city so it fits the drive back. ⚠ The seating bank rotates, and the operator warns off heart, blood-pressure and walking trouble; loud for the baby. Its yearly maintenance break fell on 2–20 December in 2024 — check before booking.

options.name: 长恨歌 Everlasting Regret
options.blurb: From ¥249 · 70 min · OUTDOORS at Huaqing Palace, next to the Terracotta Army. The famous one. ⚠ It normally shuts for winter (November to about February). A heated-seat December edition has run some years but did NOT run last winter and is not announced for 2026 — we would only know in November. Pick it if you want it if it happens.

options.name: No show — keep the evenings free
options.blurb: Skip it. The Terracotta day is already long on foot, and the Muslim Quarter, the Great Tang night walk and the Tang banquet on Friday are evenings in themselves.

decisions.title: Friday evening
decisions.question: Last night in Xi'an:

options.name: Muslim Quarter food crawl
options.blurb: The famous one: loud, crowded, delicious.

options.name: Tang Dynasty dinner show
options.blurb: Sit-down dinner with a big costumed show. Easiest for the grandparents.

options.name: Tang palace banquet
options.blurb: Dinner of Tang palace dishes with a 90-min show around the table. From ¥263 each, 19:00.

options.name: Chang'an Twelve Hours street
options.blurb: Indoor Tang market street: performers (极乐之宴 among them), snacks, costumes. ¥68 entry.

decisions.title: Saturday morning
decisions.question: Before the afternoon train back to Chengdu:

options.name: Tang costume family photos
options.blurb: Tang robes for portraits by the pagoda: about 5 people styled (kids + 1–2 adults), two stylists from 08:00.

options.name: Small Wild Goose Pagoda
options.blurb: Peaceful garden and free museum.

options.name: Slow morning
options.blurb: Sleep in, brunch, pack.

decisions.title: Sunday: the big one
decisions.question: Pick the whole day:

options.name: Leshan Giant Buddha
options.blurb: Day trip by 1h fast train. See the 71m cliff Buddha from a boat, no stairs needed.

options.name: Dujiangyan
options.blurb: Ancient waterworks, bridges and temples in green hills. 1h by van, some steps.

options.name: Du Fu Cottage + Sichuan Museum
options.blurb: Stay in town: bamboo garden in the morning, museum next door after lunch.

options.name: Dinosaur museum + easy afternoon
options.blurb: Kids' pick: giant Sichuan dinosaurs, then tea and rest.

decisions.title: Monday morning
decisions.question: Last morning (most museums are closed on Mondays):

options.name: Wenshu Monastery
options.blurb: Temple courtyards, incense and ginkgo trees.

options.name: Shopping at IFS & Chunxi Rd
options.blurb: Souvenirs, tea, Sichuan pepper.

options.name: Pool & slow morning
options.blurb: Save energy for the 1am flight.

decisions.title: Monday lunch
decisions.question: Before People's Park:

options.name: Chen Mapo Tofu
options.blurb: The famous mapo tofu house. Spicy, with 不辣 dishes for the kids.

options.name: Zhong dumplings (in the park)
options.blurb: The 1893 dumpling house, in its own pavilion inside the park. Cheap and mild.

options.name: Pan Sun Shi (braised, mild)
options.blurb: A century-old braised-meat house. Mild and cheap, with rooms.

options.name: Liao Lao Ma trotter soup
options.blurb: Milky trotter-and-bean soup: genuinely not spicy, and very cheap.

decisions.title: Monday dinner
decisions.question: Before the evening out (the opera starts at 20:00):

options.name: Tingxiang (mild Sichuan)
options.blurb: Old-mansion Sichuan that plays down the chilli. Big tables and rooms. About ¥82.

options.name: Taolin (Sichuan, ask for 不辣)

options.name: Chaoshan beef hot pot (clear broth)
options.blurb: Clear-broth beef hot pot by Kuanzhai Alley. Not spicy.

options.name: Suihe family banquet

decisions.title: Tuesday lunch

options.name: Zhuyun (inside the panda base)

options.name: Long Chao Shou wontons

options.name: Dian Dou De dim sum

options.name: Gangjiu HK café

decisions.title: Tuesday dinner

options.name: Loushang (Cantonese)

options.name: Shudaxia hot pot, split pot

options.name: Xi'an Fanzhuang (Shaanxi, mild)

options.name: Benpaoba (Shaanxi, top-rated)
options.blurb: Top-rated Shaanxi restaurant by the pagoda, about ¥58. Mixed spice.

options.name: Green Tea (Hangzhou, mild)
options.blurb: Hangzhou cooking, genuinely mild, in the mall by the pagoda.

options.name: Yunshuiyao (mushroom hot pot)

decisions.title: Thursday dinner

options.name: Xiaolongkan hot pot, split pot

options.name: Xie Lao Wu beef soup

options.name: Chuanben (next to the station)

options.name: Dinghaiji (Cantonese)

prep: Now
Vote on hotels, then book each room direct under a different Platinum/Titanium member (tips in the Hotels tab). Ask for connecting rooms and a baby cot.
Now
Passports valid 6+ months. Malaysians currently enter China visa-free for up to 30 days; re-check nearer the date.
Now
Set up Alipay (and/or WeChat Pay) with a Malaysian card and get China eSIMs. Install 高德 Amap, Didi and Trip.com.
Tue 1 Dec
Panda Base tickets + shuttle bus for Tue 15 Dec (14 days ahead).
Wed 2 Dec
Train tickets to Xi'an for Wed 16 Dec (rail sales open 15 days ahead, counting the travel day).
Sat 5 Dec
Train back Xi'an → Chengdu for Sat 19 Dec.
Sun 6 Dec
Leshan trains, there and back, for Sun 20 Dec, if Leshan wins the vote.
By 6 Dec

Book vans: Tianfu Airport pickup ~00:15 Mon 14 Dec (10 people + luggage + pram); Wed 16 hotel → Chengdu East 08:45 and Xi'an North → hotel 14:45; the Terracotta day van Thu 17; Sat 19 hotel → Xi'an North 12:15 and Chengdu East → hotel 17:48; a spare van Wed evening for the grandparents and baby; the 21:30 airport run on Mon 21 Dec.
From 7 Dec
Book private rooms 包间 or big tables for the meal places the family picked (3–7 days ahead): 10 people including a baby; ask for a high chair and any minimum spend. Haidilao books in its app.
Thu 10 Dec
Terracotta Army tickets for Thu 17 Dec (online only, 7 days ahead, passports).
Nov

Thursday-evening show, if one wins the vote: check whether 长恨歌 is running a December (冰火) season — it is usually closed in winter. 赳赳大秦 runs all year: book 10–15 days ahead, and note no under-5s and no one with heart or mobility trouble.
Sun 13 Dec

Shaanxi History Museum tickets for Fri 18 Dec: released 17:00 China time on its WeChat, gone in seconds. Pre-enter every passport before (under-6s and over-65s need none). One person on the phone at KLIA. Sold out? 14 Dec 17:00 releases Sat 19 Dec. Plan B: Small Wild Goose Pagoda + Xi'an Museum (free).
Pack

Chengdu is about 5–12°C and damp; Xi'an about −3–8°C and dry. Thermals, gloves and beanies for everyone; a pram cover and baby carrier; tissues (many toilets have none); the grandparents' medicines in hand luggage.
Rain/snow
Xi'an: Wednesday, stay in 曲江大悦城 mall; the Terracotta pits are roofed; Friday, swap the City Wall for Xi'an Museum / Small Wild Goose Pagoda.
